initial.name: run_code
initial.description: Execute a Python program against the available tools. Takes two required arguments: `code`, the BODY of an async function (top-level `await` and `return` work), and `description`, a short summary of what the program does. Call tools as `await tools.name(args)` per the declarations in the system prompt. Use `print(...)` and/or `return <value>` for program output — curate it. Image-bearing subtool results are attached after the run.

code.description: The program: the body of an async Python function.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this program does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "Count TODO markers across packages"; "Read failing test and its fixture"; "Rename config key in every cordis.yml".

initial.name: tool_search
initial.description: Search deferred tools by name and description. Returns matching callable schemas for subsequent requests.
